 American Airlines Moves Closer To Announcing New Widebody Order 
 Share
 Lori Ranson 
 October 22, 2026 
 Credit: Nigel Howarth/AWST 
 American Airlines appears to be closing in on a widebody aircraft order after a months-long campaign between rivals Boeing and Airbus. The carrier’s CFO Devon May explained during an Oct. 22 earnings discussion that American has been conducting a widebody order contest for the past six or seven...
 Lori Ranson 
 Lori covers North American and Latin airlines for Aviation Week and is also a Senior Analyst for CAPA - Centre for Aviation.
